maya: FYI build 7012 blocked on staging promote. CI shows integration:smoke failing during artifact-verify + cache write OOM at 11:05 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/7012
jay: logs snippet:
```
ERROR: artifact-verify: expected manifest sha256:cafe123 vs found sha256:deadbeef
[worker0] write shard tmp -> OOMKilled
```
ci-bot: auto-promote paused because smoke failed; promotion status: PAUSED.
tess: change-window is 11:30 PT. can we wait for a retry or pin previous?
sre-oncall: storage/cache team reports a node OOM during shard merge causing corrupted temp files; they advise quarantining 7012 and using last-good image for canary to avoid missing window.
product-lead: customer demo scheduled for 11:45 PT — we cannot miss it. prefer pinning if safe.
maya: options: 1) wait ~20m and rerun artifacts (risk miss), 2) promote previous image sha256:aa11bb to canary, 3) force-rebuild which may take >45m.
jay: vote for option 2. we can re-run CI once storage confirms artifact integrity and then roll forward if green.
deploy-bot: ready to run: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:aa11bb --reason "artifact verify mismatch build 7012"`
maya: do it. also quarantine 7012 and open bug linking storage logs.
deploy-bot: executing promote...
deploy-bot: promote complete. canary now on sha256:aa11bb, traffic routing updated. promotion_log: /deploy/logs/7955550001/step-3
tess: updating release notes + demo slack message. filing tracking ticket: ENG-5043. :memo: 
ci-bot: scheduled re-run for 7012 artifacts once storage marks shard healthy. will post status.
product-lead: thanks team. please surface any rollback risk to PMs.
maya: closing thread — change-window met. will open incident if recurrence. :thumbsup:
